div.div: فَضْيَةٌ Water collecting and stagnating: pl. فِضَاءٌ, with medd, accord. to Kr: and also ↓ فَضًى and فِصًى, with fet-h and with kesr, the former of these like حَلَقٌ as pl. [or rather a quasi-pl. n.] of حَلْقَةٌ, and the latter like بِدَرٌ as a pl. of بَدْرَةٌ; occurring in different relations of a verse of 'Adee Ibn-Er-Rikáa. (M in art. فضى, and TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
